A '''battered protocol droid''' was on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Dark Wars]]. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]] repaired him and watched a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] of a conversation between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Vandar Tokare]] and [[Vrook Lamar]].
